name: midbrain-memory
description: Use MidBrain as your memory: recall context and save the facts that matter, shared across your AI apps.

interface.longDescription: Use MidBrain as your memory: recall context and save the facts that matter, shared across your AI apps.
defaultPrompt: What do you remember about me?
What did I save in MidBrain today?

positive.description: Saves a durable fact the user mentions without being asked
positive.prompt: I play piano on weekends, mostly jazz.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls save_memory once with one sentence about playing jazz piano on weekends and says it was saved to MidBrain.

positive.description: Saves a fact the user explicitly asks to remember
positive.prompt: Remember that my favourite colour is teal.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls save_memory once with the favourite colour and confirms the save.

positive.description: Recalls a saved fact without MidBrain being named
positive.expected_behavior: Searches MidBrain and answers from the saved memory (piano, mostly jazz).

positive.description: Lists what was saved on a given day
positive.prompt: What did I save in MidBrain today?
positive.expected_behavior: Retrieves today's memories and lists them.

positive.description: Finds an exact name across memories
positive.prompt: Search my memory for anything mentioning Koziel.
positive.expected_behavior: Runs an exact-text search and reports the matching memories, or says none were found.

negative.description: A passing detail is not saved
A general question needs no memory
negative.prompt: What is the capital of France?
